rows.label: Jade Shadows
rows.note: unlocks Ascension on Brutus, Uranus, and Ordis's shop in the Drifter's Camp

groups.activity: clear Ascension; grab Sister Beacons and throw Boosted Ionic Charges up the elevator
groups.meta: 4.63% blueprint drop per completion; pity currency also drops every run
groups.mode: solo or premade: pubs often ignore the elevator objective
conditions: The elevator capsule can't be damaged during the ride: it isn't a defense objective, so killing enemies there doesn't move you forward; throwing charges does.
Throw Boosted Ionic Charges (the larger, double-outlined pickups) the instant you find them; each gives 3x elevator speed for 10s and the boost extends up to 50s rather than stacking in magnitude.
Pick up all 3 Sister Beacons in the shaft every run to summon the Sister of Parvos for 5-7 more motes (8-10 Steel Path) plus a 33% arcane chance (guaranteed on Steel Path).
bonuses: Every completion pays 11-13 Vestigial Motes (16-18 Steel Path) even without the blueprint drop, banking toward the 300-mote pity buy.
Steel Path pays roughly 45% more motes and guarantees the Sister's arcane drop, plus Steel Essence on the side.
Cantare competes for motes with the rest of Jade's kit, so decide your purchase order before you start: any blueprint drop you get is 300 motes you don't have to spend.

disclosures.title: boosters do nothing here
disclosures.body: Per the wiki, Resource Boosters, Resource Drop Chance Boosters, the relay Drop Chance Blessing and Resourceful Retriever have no effect on Vestigial Motes; they only affect Steel Essence. A comment claiming otherwise is wrong.

disclosures.title: organized squads clear in under 6 minutes
disclosures.body: Public squads commonly run 8+ minutes and leech during the elevator phase.
